mentions.name: ExploreJobs.ai
mentions.description: A job board focused on AI jobs and companies, connecting job seekers with fast-growing AI companies.
mentions.problem: Job seekers need a way to find and connect with fast-growing AI companies in a hot AI job market.
mentions.source_excerpt:
2. ExploreJobs.ai - https://explorejobs.ai

This is a job board for AI jobs and companies. The job market in AI is pretty hot right now, and there are a lot of cool AI companies out there. I'm hoping to connect job seekers with fast-growing AI companies.
